name: settleview_writer_dead_letters

query_condition.sql: SELECT reason, sum(inc) AS n FROM (SELECT reason, max(value) - CASE WHEN min(CAST(start_time AS BIGINT)) >= min(_timestamp) * 1000 - 90000000000 THEN 0 ELSE min(value) END AS inc FROM "settleview_writer_dead_lettered" WHERE 1 = 1 GROUP BY reason, __hash__, start_time) GROUP BY reason HAVING sum(inc) >= 1

description: Writes dead-lettered: they need a replay.
